{C : Type u_1} →
  {D : Type u_2} →
    [inst : CategoryTheory.Category.{u_3, u_1} C] →
      [inst_1 : CategoryTheory.Category.{u_4, u_2} D] →
        {F : CategoryTheory.Functor.{u_3, u_4, u_1, u_2} C D} →
          {G : CategoryTheory.Functor.{u_4, u_3, u_2, u_1} D C} →
            CategoryTheory.Adjunction.{u_3, u_4, u_1, u_2} F G →
              (X : C) →
                CategoryTheory.Functor.CorepresentableBy.{u_3, u_4, u_2}
                  (CategoryTheory.Functor.comp.{u_4, u_3, u_3, u_2, u_1, u_3 + 1} G
                    (CategoryTheory.Functor.obj.{u_3, max u_1 u_3, u_1, max u_1 (u_3 + 1)}
                      CategoryTheory.coyoneda.{u_3, u_1} (Opposite.op.{u_1 + 1} X)))
                  (CategoryTheory.Functor.obj.{u_3, u_4, u_1, u_2} F X)

{C : Type u_1} →
  {D : Type u_2} →
    [inst : CategoryTheory.Category.{u_3, u_1} C] →
      [inst_1 : CategoryTheory.Category.{u_4, u_2} D] →
        {F : CategoryTheory.Functor.{u_3, u_4, u_1, u_2} C D} →
          {G : CategoryTheory.Functor.{u_4, u_3, u_2, u_1} D C} →
            CategoryTheory.Adjunction.{u_3, u_4, u_1, u_2} F G →
              (Y : D) →
                CategoryTheory.Functor.RepresentableBy.{u_4, u_3, u_1}
                  (CategoryTheory.Functor.comp.{u_3, u_4, u_4, u_1, u_2, u_4 + 1}
                    (CategoryTheory.Functor.op.{u_3, u_4, u_1, u_2} F)
                    (CategoryTheory.Functor.obj.{u_4, max u_2 u_4, u_2, max u_2 (u_4 + 1)}
                      CategoryTheory.yoneda.{u_4, u_2} Y))
                  (CategoryTheory.Functor.obj.{u_4, u_3, u_2, u_1} G Y)
